description: Conversations of up to 5 voices (20 languages) that sound like a dialogue: natural turn-taking and a steady voice per speaker. Each speaker clones from a 3–10 s reference clip plus its transcript. Experimental.

settings.label: Reference transcript
settings.description: The exact words spoken in the reference clip. Required when the speaker has a clip. Without a clip the model invents a voice.

settings.label: Stop temperature
settings.description: How loosely the model decides when to stop. Lower values make early stops less likely.
